resultMethod.spreadHdpSemantics: raw hdp is the home-side handicap; away selected handicap is the opposite sign
resultMethod.quarterLineSemantics: quarter lines split into two equal half-stakes on the adjacent half-goal/half-point lines
resultMethod.unsupportedMarkets: remain unresolved unless exact selection verification is supplied
resultMethod.isolation: historical result providers and immutable issued snapshots only; no live odds or report-production inputs

method.issuedPrice: best fresh exact quote among the books named on the issued card, resolved from the immutable snapshot whose generatedAt exactly matches source feedGeneratedAt
method.issuedPriceFreshness: quoteObservedAt must be no more than 30 minutes before source feedGeneratedAt; quoteUpdatedAt preserves the provider price-change timestamp
method.comparisonBook: same normalized sportsbook selected for analysisPrice at issuance
method.window: comparison snapshot generated after source feedGeneratedAt and before recommendation commenceTime
method.label: last observed pre-start price; not a verified closing line
